summary: Frontend-only dark mode feature test. Overall PASS with one visual regression: native <input>/<textarea> elements (no explicit bg-white class) render with browser-default white background inside dark themeable containers and dialogs. Affects Configuración tab and 'Nueva auditoría' dialog.

ui_bugs.issue: 2 <input> elements show white background (rgb(255,255,255)) in dark mode. Inputs use classes 'border border-slate-300 focus:border-[#0284C7] outline-none px-3 py-2.5' but no bg-white or dark:bg-* — browser default white leaks through.

1 input + 1 textarea display white background on dark modal (visible in screenshot /tmp/dialog.png). Same class pattern: 'w-full border border-slate-300 focus:border-[#0284C7] outline-none px-4 py-3'.

issues: Native form inputs without bg-white class render white in dark mode — text (dark) becomes invisible/hard to read

action_items: Add CSS override in /app/frontend/src/dark-theme.css to target native inputs/textareas inside .themeable and [role=dialog]. Suggested: `.dark :is(.themeable, [role="dialog"], [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]) :is(input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]), textarea, select) { background-color: #0F172A; color: #F1F5F9; }` — or explicitly add `bg-white dark:bg-[#0F172A]` classes to those inputs.
Also override placeholder color: `::placeholder { color: #64748B }` to keep readable in dark mode.
critical_code_review_comments: dark-theme.css relies exclusively on Tailwind utility class selectors (e.g. .bg-white) to override colors. Any element styled with pure CSS defaults (native <input>, <textarea>) is missed. Consider a base rule targeting form elements directly inside .dark .themeable.
ThemeContext reads localStorage during useState init (SSR-safe since CRA is CSR) — OK.

rca of the issue: Root cause: dark-theme.css scopes overrides via Tailwind utility class selectors (.bg-white, .bg-slate-50, etc.). Native form elements (input, textarea, select) that don't carry an explicit background utility class fall back to the browser's user-agent stylesheet which paints them white. Repro: login as admin → Configuración tab, or Auditorías → Nueva auditoría button. Fix: add a rule targeting form elements directly, e.g. `.dark :is(.themeable, [role="dialog"]) :is(input, textarea, select):not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]) { background-color:#0F172A; color:#F1F5F9; }`.
